title: 第二十五章 浮生若梦（二）
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
狂风在荒芜之地卷动着砂石呼啸而过，她艰难地仰起头，视线如同隔着一层无法穿透的浓雾，模糊不清，唯有对方那一头在风中肆意狂舞的墨色长发，以及那双因悲恸而赤红眼眸，好似下一刻就要淌下殷红泪珠，灼烧着她逐渐涣散的感知。

    他猛地收紧臂膀，将她紧紧嵌入怀中，冰冷的薄唇微微颤抖，随即低头轻轻印在她的额间。

    谢清猗长睫轻颤，眸中氤氲着水雾，尽管无法辨认他的容貌，可他周身传来的绝望与死意，如同胸前的利刃狠狠刨开她的心脏。

    从未有过，那般难以言喻的酸涩与悲痛瞬间蔓延开来，此时她只剩下无尽的不舍与委屈，而喉咙哽咽地疼痛，带来的窒息感，与精神的溃散几乎要将她的神魂彻底吞没。

    就在意识即将彻底消散，堕入永恒黑暗的一刹。

    额间被他亲吻过的地方，骤然灼热！

    一抹殷红如朱砂的血印，在她光洁的额间悄然浮现。

    与此同时，胸口猛地一震，周身的灵力以前所未有的狂烈之势奔涌流转！

    天旋地转戛然而止，她感到灵台瞬间清明。

    谢清猗倏然回神，面前凭空浮现‘浮生若梦’四字，眨眼间那字又化为云雾散去，她这才惊觉，刚才那爱恨痴缠，生死一线，正是凶险无比的虚空法阵‘浮生若梦’。

    自她从那法阵中挣脱后，立即察觉到周遭地异样，仙府弟子皆是双目紧闭，面上的神情各有不同，看来，大家还沉溺于各自无法自拔的幻境之中。

    她望向四周这片看似唯美瑰丽的鸢尾花海，顿时明了，这无尽的花海，正是将人拖入虚空法阵的致命关键。

    忆起原书，只说此阵诡异无常，入阵者所见景象人人不同，或是沉沦于过往回忆，亦或是沉溺于虚妄梦想。

    在阵中滞留愈久，法阵越会让人彻底迷失，难辨真伪，神魂便如同被烈火蒸腾，愈发不稳，直至最终，三魂俱灭，彻底沦为这花海的养料。
content_en:
The strong wind whipped the sand and gravel past in the desolate land, and she raised her head with difficulty. Her vision was blurred as if through a layer of impenetrable thick fog. Only the other person's long dark hair dancing wildly in the wind, and her eyes that were red with grief, seemed to be about to shed bright red tears at the next moment, burning her gradually weakened perception.

    He tightened his arms suddenly and pressed her tightly into his arms. His cold thin lips trembled slightly, and then he lowered his head and pressed her forehead gently.

    Xie Qingyi's long eyelashes trembled slightly, and there was mist in her eyes. Although his appearance could not be recognized, the despair and death around him was like a sharp knife on her chest, ruthlessly ripping open her heart.

    Never before, such indescribable sourness and grief spread instantly. At this time, she was left with endless reluctance and grievance, and the pain in her throat, the suffocation, and the collapse of her spirit almost completely swallowed her soul.

    At the moment when consciousness is about to completely dissipate and fall into eternal darkness.

    The place where he kissed her forehead suddenly became hot!

    A trace of blood, as red as cinnabar, quietly appeared on her smooth forehead.

    At the same time, his chest shook violently, and the spiritual energy around him surged with unprecedented ferocity!

    The whirlwind of heaven and earth suddenly stopped, and she felt that the spiritual platform was instantly clear.

    Xie Qingyi suddenly came back to her senses, and the four words "Floating Life Like a Dream" appeared out of thin air in front of her. In the blink of an eye, the words turned into clouds and dispersed. Only then did she realize that the love-hate obsession, life and death, was the extremely dangerous void magic circle "Floating Life Like a Dream".

    After she broke free from the magic circle, she immediately noticed something strange around her. All the disciples in the Immortal Palace had their eyes closed tightly, with different expressions on their faces. It seemed that everyone was still addicted to their own illusions that they couldn't extricate themselves from.

    She looked at the seemingly beautiful and magnificent sea of ​​iris flowers around her, and suddenly understood that this endless sea of ​​flowers was the fatal key to dragging people into the void magic circle.

    Recalling the original book, I only said that this formation was strange and unpredictable. Everyone who entered the formation saw different scenes. They were either addicted to past memories or indulged in false dreams.

    The longer one stays in the formation, the more completely lost the magic formation becomes, making it difficult to tell the truth from the false. The soul becomes more and more unstable as if being steamed by raging fire, until eventually, all three souls are destroyed, completely reduced to the nourishment of this sea of ​​flowers.
title_en: Chapter 25: Life is like a dream (2)
